column1: # repo<TAB>PR number<TAB>one-line description<TAB>type (bug fix | speedup | tests/CI | tool; optional, default bug fix). tools/render_bio_prs.py fills status from the GitHub API.

column3: `predict_query` no longer writes its options into the caller's query dict
Leading-decimal answers like `.701` keep their value when graded
Report summaries keep metrics whose scores are all 0
FDA adverse-event summaries count deaths and hospitalizations from the report-level flags
`query_openfda` sends its search, sort, count and skip parameters
Glob patterns match the whole file name (`*.fq` no longer matches `a.fq.gz`)
`generate-metadata` handles nf-core schema patterns that crashed it (55 to 124 of 146 pipelines)
Rollouts record a copy of each executed action, so a reused policy buffer can't change scores
Trial artifacts stay separate for scene IDs that differ only in case
Scan energy positions, explicit empty pKa element lists, and folder lookup past the first page
Converted metro maps keep edges into dead-end processes in other sections
Subworkflows with the same short name get separate sections instead of overwriting each other
get_model works against real PyMOL (Indexed was imported from the wrong module)
Relative file paths are resolved by PyMOL, as documented, not by the MCP server
Merging A3M files from the same database keeps every file's hits
The UniProt skill's PDB helper puts the chains, not the resolution, in its chains field
The setup check uses modal token info, since modal token show does not exist
Heavy-atom RMSD searches symmetry mappings, so symmetric conformers compare as identical
random_seed=0 gives reproducible conformers instead of an unseeded run
Transition-metal conversions keep input atom order and supplied coordinates
Template lookup keeps chain names like 001 or NA as strings
create-params-file includes parameters defined at the schema's top level
Schema build keeps 0 and 0.0 defaults from the pipeline config
Tool servers build for tools with list parameters (JSON Schema "array")
Float64 Tensor input works in transform and compute_contributions, like NumPy input
A module set only in top_modules no longer runs a second time on all logs
Text parsing compares page_size_limit with each line's length, not the line count
Rebuilding an index with use_absolute_paper_directory keeps unchanged documents
scbench batch skips evals/manifest.json instead of counting it as a failed eval
py.typed marker so type checkers use the package's annotations (issue #18)
Tool servers pass a parameter's declared default when the request leaves it out
Gene mapping uses the detected gene-name column, so genes named only there aren't dropped
score_agg_metrics works when one normalization group is empty
Pipeline metric settings no longer leak into other pipelines' defaults
An interrupted shard merge no longer leaves a truncated checkpoint that later loads accept
Drug recall search applies the requested classification filter
Adverse-event search reports FDA API errors instead of 'no adverse events found'
